list_text:
Shared Clickys you can install (ask for one by its id):
- job-hunter: 💼 Job Hunter by @mohit. Keeps my job search moving with one short update a day. Runs every 24 hours, about 30 agent messages a month.
- follow-up-keeper: 📬 Follow-up Keeper by @mohit (example). Catches email threads where someone has waited more than 3 days for your reply. Runs every 48 hours, about 15 agent messages a month.
- weekly-wins: 🏁 Weekly Wins by @mohit (example). Turns your week into a 5-line recap, once a week. Runs every 7 days, about 4 agent messages a month.

clickys.name: Job Hunter
clickys.one_line_job: Keeps my job search moving with one short update a day.
clickys.why_i_use_it: I built this for my own job search, where replies, interview invites and follow-ups slip through. It puts them in one short daily update. A daily routine needs about 30 agent messages a month, so on Free it runs out before the month does. That's why every shared Clicky shows its cost.
clickys.instructions: Once a day, check my email for replies from companies or recruiters and list them with the next step for each. Flag any interview invites and propose times from my calendar. Suggest one follow-up email I should send today and draft it. Keep the whole update under 120 words. Never send an email without asking me first.
clickys.first_task: Look at my inbox from the last 7 days and tell me where each application stands.
clickys.setup_text:
Here is the exact shared setup for a new Clicky (shared by @mohit via Share-a-Clicky).
Name: Job Hunter
Personality: Direct, encouraging, never wordy.
Job: Once a day, check my email for replies from companies or recruiters and list them with the next step for each. Flag any interview invites and propose times from my calendar. Suggest one follow-up email I should send today and draft it. Keep the whole update under 120 words. Never send an email without asking me first.
Apps it needs: Gmail, Google Calendar
Routine: Every 24 hours. Once you're created, set up this routine.
First task: Look at my inbox from the last 7 days and tell me where each application stands.

Show the person the setup above exactly as written and tell them: "Click + (New Clicky) and paste this. Then connect Gmail and Google Calendar when it asks, and tell the new Clicky to create its routine."

clickys.name: Follow-up Keeper
clickys.one_line_job: Catches email threads where someone has waited more than 3 days for your reply.
clickys.why_i_use_it: An example of a small, cheap routine: it runs every other day and only drafts, never sends.
clickys.instructions: Every other day, find email threads where someone is waiting on my reply for more than 3 days. List them oldest first with one line on what they need. Draft a short reply for the top two. Never send anything without asking me first.
clickys.first_task: Show me every thread from the last 14 days where I still owe someone a reply.

Routine: Every 48 hours. Once you're created, set up this routine.
First task: Show me every thread from the last 14 days where I still owe someone a reply.

clickys.name: Weekly Wins
clickys.one_line_job: Turns your week into a 5-line recap, once a week.

clickys.instructions: Once a week, look at my sent email and calendar for the past 7 days. Write a 5-line recap of what I got done, who I met, and what's next. Offer to turn it into a short update I can send to a mentor.

tools.name: get_shared_clicky
